2609.04895.title: Cache-Aware Joint Router Adaptation for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference
2609.04895.paper_summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models activate only a small subset of experts per token, but the full expert set often exceeds GPU memory, causing repeated weight transfers during decoding. We formulate expert-cache management as a model-side algorithmic problem and propose a cache-aware post-training framework that jointly adapts the MoE backbone and lightweight auxiliary cache routers while preserving the native Top-K expert-selection rule at inference. Its update-only mode, Temporal Router, predicts same-layer reuse and retains experts for future tokens without proactive loading. The full Spatio-Temporal Router adds a Spatio Router that uses the causal predecessor's hidden state to refine the temporal cache before target-layer access. We evaluate both modes on Qwen3 and GPT-OSS across GSM8K, MATH, and CommonsenseQA. Temporal Router consistently improves cache hit rate and reduces expert-weight traffic over matched LM-only baselines. On Qwen3, Spatio-Temporal Router achieves the best load-adjusted efficiency across three tasks, improving adjusted hit rate by 1.15--18.03 points and reducing traffic by 4.6--53.3% relative to the strongest evaluated prefetching baseline; results on GPT-OSS are competitive but task-dependent. An auxiliary-only ablation preserves baseline accuracy but yields modest cache gains, whereas joint post-training produces larger improvements. Sensitivity analyses show that cache capacity controls transfer demand, while the refinement budget governs the trade-off between pre-access coverage and proactive traffic.
2609.04895.paper_summary_zh: 混合專家（MoE）模型每個標記僅啟用一小部分專家，但完整的專家集通常超過 GPU 記憶體，導致在解碼過程中需要重複進行權重轉移。<lb/>我們將專家快取管理制定為一個模型側的算法問題，並提出一個快取感知的後訓練框架，該框架在保持推理時原生的 Top-K 專家選擇規則的同時，聯合調整 MoE 主幹和輕量級輔助快取路由器。<lb/>其更新模式，時間路由器，預測同層重用並保留專家以供未來標記使用，而無需主動加載。<lb/>完整的時空路由器增加了一個時空路由器，該路由器利用因果前驅的隱藏狀態來優化目標層訪問之前的時間快取。<lb/>我們在 Qwen3 和 GPT-OSS 上對 GSM8K、MATH 和 CommonsenseQA 評估了這兩種模式。<lb/>時間路由器持續提高快取命中率，並減少專家權重流量，相較於匹配的僅 LM 基準。<lb/>在 Qwen3 上，時空路由器在三個任務中實現了最佳的負載調整效率，調整命中率提高了 1.15--18.03 點，並相對於最強的評估預取基準減少了 4.6--53.3% 的流量；在 GPT-OSS 上的結果具有競爭力，但依賴於任務。<lb/>僅輔助的消融實驗保持了基準準確性，但帶來了適度的快取增益，而聯合後訓練則產生了更大的改進。<lb/>敏感性分析顯示，快取容量控制轉移需求，而精煉預算則決定了預訪問覆蓋與主動流量之間的權衡。
